summary.key_theme: Arm Holdings 正面臨 AI 成長潛力與 Qualcomm 法律訴訟風險之間的拉鋸戰。

bullish.title: Arm Holdings: Agentic AI Shift Provides A Catalyst For Growth (Rating Upgrade)
bullish.reason: Armv9 架構的成功推動授權營收成長，分析師看好 Agentic AI 趨勢將成為長期成長催化劑。

bullish.title: Munro Partners Sees Arm Holdings (ARM) as a Key Beneficiary of Agentic AI
bullish.reason: 知名投資機構 Munro Partners 將 Arm 列為 AI 轉型的主要受益者，增強市場信心。

bullish.title: Arm Holdings Stock Closed Above Wall Street’s $289 Target. Here’s the Margin Math That Decides What Comes Next
bullish.reason: 股價突破華爾街目標價，顯示市場對其獲利能力與成長空間的高度認可。

bullish.title: ARM vs. Marvell Technology: What Revenue Trends for These Artificial Intelligence Companies Tell Investors
bullish.reason: 儘管 Marvell 營收領先，但 Arm 近期財報顯示出強勁的成長加速跡象。

bearish.title: Arm Holdings (ARM) Heads To Trial Over Billions In Royalty Payments
bearish.reason: Arm 與 Qualcomm 針對權利金與合約違約進入聯邦審判，涉及金額龐大，若敗訴將嚴重影響營收結構。

bearish.title: Qualcomm Takes Arm to Court Over Withheld Chip Testing Tools and Leaked Deal Threats
bearish.reason: Qualcomm 指控 Arm 扣留晶片測試工具並威脅終止合約，此法律糾紛可能損害 Arm 與客戶的信任關係。

bearish.title: Will Selling Chips Strengthen Arm’s Moat or Put It at Risk?
bearish.reason: 市場質疑 Arm 自行銷售晶片是否會與現有授權客戶產生利益衝突，進而削弱其商業護城河。

neutral.title: Arm Announces Earnings Release Date for Second Quarter Fiscal Year Ending 2027
neutral.reason: 僅為例行性的財報發布日期公告，對股價無直接影響。

neutral.title: Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights: Arm Holdings, Advanced Micro Devices, Marvell, Applied Optoelectronics and Nebius
neutral.reason: 僅為投資建議清單提及，未提供針對 Arm 的具體新觀點。
